title: Full-Stack Developer
description:
We are helping our partners at Risklick, a Swiss tech company working in the pharmaceutical and clinical research field, to find a Full-Stack Developer for their product team.

Their main product, Protocol AI, is an AI-powered platform for working with clinical trial protocols and related documentation.
 

Responsibilities:

  • Developing new features and improving existing functionality.
  • Working on both backend and frontend parts of the product.
  • Designing and implementing new modules and integrations.
  • Working with databases and optimizing existing application logic.
  • Participating in technical and architectural discussions.
  • Working with documents and structured data.
  • Collaborating with the product and engineering team in English.
     

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of commercial development experience.
  • Strong experience with TypeScript and Node.js.
  • Hands-on experience with Next.js and React.
  • Experience with Prisma and PostgreSQL.
  • Strong backend background and understanding of application architecture.
  • Experience with full-stack product development.
  • Good English for daily communication and technical discussions.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of your tasks.

A candidate who started as a Backend Developer and later moved into full-stack development would be a particularly good fit.
 

Nice to have:

  • Experience in Pharma, MedTech, HealthTech, or clinical research.
  • Experience with document-heavy products or document processing.
  • Experience with AI development tools.
     

What we offer:

  • Fully remote, full-time cooperation.
  • Working hours: 10:00–18:30 Kyiv time.
  • No time trackers.
  • Jira and Slack for day-to-day work.
  • Claude Code as part of the development workflow.
  • English-speaking work environment.
  • Compensation discussed in gross.
